title: MARS OS data handoff — USGS SIM 3464 + Perseverance PLACES R16
scientificStatus: PLACES track derived and checksum-verified; SIM 3464 catalog metadata verified, GIS layer pending conversion

files.role: derived visualization data; one LineString per sol
files.generator: CSV rows frame=ROVER; sort within sol by SCLK; lon, planetocentric_latitude; drop consecutive identical coordinates

limitations: GeoJSON represents the historical Perseverance traverse, not a safe astronaut route.
PLACES R16 omits ROVER,n,0 positions from best_interp.csv; see official release notes.
SIM 3464 regional geologic database has not been transformed into a browser-renderable map layer.
SIM 3464 has documented ~100–200 m random offsets relative to controlled CTX used for surface ops; do not imply pixel-level registration.
